name: mixed-sentiment
description: Reviews that praise one theme and fault another in the same body. This is the capability the Claude engine exists for (SPEC.md: 'one review can yield praise for one theme and a fault for another') and the one the rating-based heuristic engine structurally cannot represent. Scoring is label-agnostic: it never asks the model to guess a theme name, only whether it split polarity across distinct themes and anchored each side in the right clause. `praiseClause` and `faultClause` are exact, non-overlapping substrings of `text`.
